title: Anant Raj shares in focus on Rs 4500crore investment plan in Andhra Pradesh
summary: Anant Raj will be in focus after announcing a Rs 4,500 crore investment to set up a data centre and IT park in Andhra Pradesh through its subsidiary ARCPL. The project is expected to create 16,000 jobs and add to its ongoing 307 MW data centre capacity expansion. Strong Q2FY26 results, rising revenues, and new real estate project clearances further highlight the company’s growth momentum.

title: Alembic Pharmaceuticals shares in focus after USFDA nod for key hypertension drug
summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals will be in focus after securing final USFDA approval for Diltiazem Hydrochloride Tablets, a widely used treatment for high blood pressure and angina. The drug is deemed therapeutically equivalent to Bausch Health’s Cardizem. With this approval, Alembic’s total ANDA count rises to 230. The stock closed at Rs 904.20 on Friday, down 14% so far in 2025.

title: Muthoot Finance among 6 stocks witnessing 5year swing high breakouts
summary: A 5-year swing high represents the highest price a stock has reached within a five-year period. This level often acts as a significant resistance zone where the price has historically struggled to move higher.

title: Maruti Suzuki shares in focus as company recalls 39506 Grand Vitara units
summary: Maruti Suzuki will be in focus after recalling 39,506 Grand Vitara SUVs manufactured between December 2024 and April 2025 due to faulty fuel-level indicators. The company will inspect and replace parts free of cost. The recall comes as the Grand Vitara remains a top performer, driven by rising demand for its Strong Hybrid variants. Maruti’s stock closed at Rs 15,678 on Friday.

title: Tata Motors PV shares in focus on JLR  guidance cut Q2 net profit on onetime gain
summary: Tata Motors shares are under investor watch. The company reported weak September quarter results. Its luxury unit, Jaguar Land Rover, also cut its guidance. This follows a cyber incident impacting Jaguar Land Rover's performance. Despite challenges, Tata Motors' domestic operations showed resilience. The company's multi-powertrain portfolio, including EVs, drove growth.

title: Kotak Mahindra Bank shares in focus as board considers first stock split in 15 years Check details
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank's board will consider a share split proposal on November 21, potentially making its stock more accessible. The bank's Q2 earnings met expectations, though margins saw a sequential dip. Analysts remain cautious, citing underperformance in NIM and slippage trends compared to peers.
